messages:
lisa_cs: FYI we have a customer ticket — production app from AcmeCorp showing 2-3x latency and occasional 503s since ~10:12 UTC. They say traffic should hit us-east but traces show eu-west backends. request_id=01FZ9T9K2X7AB4, sample curl attached.

 diana_support: Can you paste the request headers & a repro curl? Any auth/billing errors in the ticket?

 lisa_cs: They pasted this curl and headers:

 curl -v https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/generate \
   -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_..." \
   -H "X-Client-Region: us-east-1" \
   -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
   -d '{"model":"rw-4z","prompt":"hello"}'

 But their SDK attaches a query param region=eu-west-1 (legacy env var). So actual request URL ends up: https://api.../v1/generate?region=eu-west-1

 mike_ops: Looking at routing logs for request_id=01FZ9T9K2X7AB4: incoming metadata shows both header X-Client-Region=us-east-1 and query.region=eu-west-1. Our router currently uses param precedence (region param wins) — changed in config PR #834 to make explicit region param override header to let CLI overrides work. That PR rolled out yesterday to all edge nodes.

 tejas_eng: Repro'd locally: when both present we route to param region. Snippet:

 # simplified pseudolog
 INCOMING: client_ip=3.80.12.5 X-Client-Region=us-east-1 query.region=eu-west-1
 ROUTER: pick region=eu-west-1 -> forward to eu-west pool
 BACKEND: serve from eu-west -> 120ms extra due to cross-region

 mike_ops: This explains latency spike and 503s for some flows (idle warm pools in eu-west caused cold starts). Also noticed a couple of billing reports showing tokens billed in eu-west project, customer billing appears normal but confusing to them.

 diana_support: Customer says they never set region param. It was added by their ops via legacy SDK config. They want requests to honor X-Client-Region header.

 tejas_eng: Proposed fixes:
 - short term: patch router to prefer X-Client-Region over query param if header present and authenticated user belongs to region group (fast rollback of PR #834 behavior)
 - medium term: add validation warning: if header and param disagree, return 400 with message or at least a warning header X-Region-Conflict and log metric
 - long term: deprecate query param-based region override; add SDK/CLI migration docs and telemetry

 sanjay_platform: Agree. Also propose a traffic rule: if mismatch -> fail open to user's preferred region (header) for first 5s, but emit alert and increment counter. We should avoid sudden failovers that cause cold starts.

 diana_support: Repro steps for customer + support team to validate fix:
 1) run curl with header only -> verify routing to us-east
 2) run curl with region query param only -> verify routing to eu-west
 3) run curl with header + param (mismatch) -> verify router behavior and capture X-Region-Decision header
 4) provide request_id and 5mins of logs

 tejas_eng: Here's a quick local test for eng:

 # curl with mismatch
 curl -s -D- -o /dev/null "https://api.../v1/generate?region=eu-west-1" \
   -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_..." \
   -H "X-Client-Region: us-east-1" \
   -d '{"model":"rw-4z","prompt":"ping"}'

 Expect response header: X-Region-Decision: eu-west-1 (current behavior)

 mike_ops: Rolling a hotfix to edge config now that reverts precedence to header-first for requests that include X-Client-Region and an authenticated org region binding. I'll push config and target canary to 10% edge nodes.

 deploy-bot: deploy started: edge-config-revert-834 -> canary(10%) by mike_ops @ 1712003750

 deploy-bot: canary success: 10% nodes updated (checks OK)

 lisa_cs: Sent interim note to AcmeCorp explaining root cause and that we are rolling a fix to prefer X-Client-Region; asked them to check if they can remove legacy region query param in SDK env to prevent future trouble.

 diana_support: After canary, please run repro steps and paste request_ids. I'll keep ticket open until we confirm 24h stability. Also file a postmortem note referencing PR #834 and this slack thread.

 mike_ops: Canary looks good. Gradual rollout to 100% scheduled over next 20m. Also added a new alert: region-conflict-rate > 0.1% of requests -> paging oncall.

 tejas_eng: I'll add unit tests asserting header vs param precedence and add API-level warning header when mismatch happens. Also will schedule SDK deprecation message.

 deploy-bot: rollout complete -> 100% edges updated @ 1712004025

 mike_ops: Marking as resolved internally but keeping support ticket open until customer confirms. Key next steps in case of recurrence:
 - collect raw request (headers + querystring)
 - send request_id + approximate user-org region mapping
 - check edge config version via header X-Edge-Version

 lisa_cs: Customer confirmed latency normalized and no more eu-west billing. Closing ticket once 24h check passes. :thumbsup:
